about.leadPre: From an idea on paper to a system that
about.body: I work both ends of the build: backend logic and database structure underneath, and the interface people actually touch on top. The idea does not stop at a prototype — it ends as a system that runs, stays secure, and can be handed to anyone.

values.title: Idea to system
values.desc: Requirements, structure, and the build that carries them through.

values.title: Secure by design
values.desc: Permissions, validation, and data protection built in — not bolted on after.

values.title: Clear and easy to use
values.desc: Interfaces people find their way through without being taught.

values.title: Clean, readable code
values.desc: Organised and documented, so any developer can take it over.

skills.leadPre: Tools are the easy part. The skill is knowing
skills.leadEm: which layer a problem belongs to.

layers.name: Data
layers.desc: Schema design, relations, and queries that stay fast as the table grows.

layers.name: Server
layers.desc: Business logic, authentication, roles and permissions, APIs.

layers.name: Interface
layers.desc: Design-faithful implementation, state management, responsive behaviour.

layers.name: Handover
layers.desc: Work another developer can pick up: reviewed, documented, versioned.
